question: Kailan nag-eexpire ang business permit sa Davao at ano ang basic requirements para mag-renew sa January?
answer: Ang business permit sa Davao City expire sa 31st of December. Para mag-renew sa January, ang mga basic requirements sa checklist na kinabibilangan sa [S3] at [S4] sa City Treasurer's CGD_Citizen Charter 2026_VOL.I & II-2.pdf. Ang mga requirement na kinabibilangan ay ang application for business permit renewal at application for renewal of Mayor's Permit, bawat isa sa isa ay isang original at isang duplica. [S3] at [S4]

ground_truth: A Mayor's Business Permit in Davao City is valid for not more than one (1) year and expires on December 31 following issuance. Renewal must be filed within the month of January. Mandatory renewal requirements are: 1) List of Employees stating names and positions (1 copy); 2) Notarized Special Power of Attorney (Sole Proprietorship), Partnership Resolution, or Board Resolution/Secretary's Certificate (Corporation/Cooperative) if represented; 3) Valid ID of representative; 4) Valid Fire Safety Inspection Certificate (FSIC) (1 photocopy); and 5) Specific clearances for regulated business lines.
